newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine pension funds yield 19.34 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Argentine pension funds yield 19.34 pct in April.

text.p: Argentina's private pension funds obtained an average return of 19.34 percent on their investments in the year to April, the Superintendency of Pension and Retirement Funds, the body that monitors the funds, said Friday.
In the year to March, the funds, known by their Spanish acronym AFJPs, achieved an average return of 22.15 percent.
The maximum return attained in the year to April was 25.14 percent, while the lowest was 13.54 percent, the Superintendency said.
The average annual return since the private pension funds were first established in the middle of 1994 was 18.09 percent.
